description: This file contains unit tests for the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI class within the Recruitment API module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests functionalities such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, focusing on the API's behavior during candidate interview pass marking.

classes.name: CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPITest
